count.description: Number of records with this facet value. [The count may be approximated](https://support.algolia.com/hc/articles/4406975248145-Why-are-my-facet-and-hit-counts-not-accurate).

exhaustiveFacetsCount.description:
Whether the facet count is exhaustive (true) or approximate (false).
For more information, see [Why are my facet and hit counts not accurate](https://support.algolia.com/hc/articles/4406975248145-Why-are-my-facet-and-hit-counts-not-accurate).

highlightedValue.description: Highlighted attribute value, including HTML tags.

processingTimeMS.description: Time the server took to process the request, in milliseconds.
